text.en:
The sitios of Villa Riza, Cansayong and Can-aga are hereby separated from their respective
mother barangay and constituted into three (3) new separate barangays to be respectively known as Barangay
Villa Riza, Barangay Cansayong and Barangay Can-aga, all in the Municipality of Malimono, Province of
Surigao del Norte.

After ratification by the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be conducted in the areas
affected, within a period of ninety (90) days after the approval of this Act, the President shall appoint the
officials of the new barangays. Said official shall hold office until their successors shall have been duly
elected and qualified.

The barangays herein created shall begin to exist upon appointment and qualification of their
respective officers.

The Commission on Elections shall conduct and supervise the holding of the plebiscite and the
expenses for such plebiscite shall be charged to the appropriations of the Commission on Elections for said

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 13, 1984
